cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Hide Inside the Callback
cards.instruction: Use an early harmless detail as the explanation for each new consequence, keeping your own role outside the pattern.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. That innocent cup started the argument. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You tipped it onto my letter.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Exactly. A badly positioned cup creates difficult choices.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which shows how far the cup had already entered the situation.
